title: Pinning first-run quickstart frames and fallback composer assets
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and deliver a compact first-run quickstart experience that teaches customers how to set up version pinning and rollout policies. Includes a 4-step interactive carousel, annotated product screenshots, a fallback-policy composer prototype, small-screen responsive variants, and a short animation demonstrating canary -> promote -> pin flow. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for engineers and PMs evaluating Rollouts features.
acceptance_criteria: Four carousel frames that map to: 1) Pin vs dynamic routing overview, 2) Create a canary, 3) A/B split example, 4) Fallback policy composer walkthrough
Three annotated screenshots (desktop, tablet, mobile) with redlines for spacing, copy, and CTA placement
Interactive Figma prototype for the fallback-policy composer showing: add rule, set threshold, set fallback target, save
One micro-animation (MP4, 4s) that shows traffic shifting from baseline -> canary -> promoted pinned version
Exported PNG/JPEG assets for doc hero, two step-by-step thumbnails, and a compact spritesheet for the quickstart modal
Design handoff notes and a small spec doc with tokenized spacing, colors, and component states for engineering
